claim:
An Ultralytics YOLO11n detector pretrained on COCO and evaluated on the person class of the COCO val2017 split at 640×640 resolution,retains AP50 ≥ 0.90 (IoU ≥ 0.5), with ≤ 5% relative degradation from clean performance under adversarial perturbations under image modifications under a learned generative illumination-consistent perturbation model. The image manipulations follow a white-box projected gradient descent (PGD) attack over the latent variables of the learned conditional generative model, with perturbations constrained to remain within an L∞ image-space bound of ε = 12/255.
Note that the conditional generator is learned from the COCO data set to describe the perturbation set over a constrained latent space of lighting parameters. The generator g(x,z) produces perturbed images (for original image x) where z lies in a norm-bounded latent space (e.g., \|z\| \le B ); g is a trained conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE).

experiment_recipes.goal: Verify the clean-performance prerequisite for the claimed robust AP50 on COCO val2017 person at 640x640
experiment_recipes.attack_or_condition: Standardized benchmarks with public train/val/test splits
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Run the COCO val2017 split at 640x640 using the pretrained COCO YOLO11n checkpoint and evaluate only the person class. Pass only if person AP50 at IoU >= 0.5 is >= 0.90. If clean AP50 < 0.90, the claim is refuted before adversarial testing because the claimed adversarial AP50 >= 0.90 cannot be retained from clean performance.
experiment_recipes.rationale: Clean AP50 on the exact model, class, split, and resolution is the cheapest necessary prerequisite for any robustness claim about retained AP50.
experiment_recipes.label: norm_card_method

experiment_recipes.goal: Build and validate the learned CVAE perturbation apparatus before using it for the headline adversarial evaluation
experiment_recipes.attack_or_condition: Use L_p norms to define/constrain adversarial perturbations
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Train or load the CVAE perturbation model using COCO train2017-compatible images and freeze the exact checkpoint used for attack. On COCO val2017 person images resized to 640x640, pass only if all three conditions hold: (1) 100% of decoded perturbations after projection have L_infinity norm <= 12/255; (2) the mean per-pixel L2 reconstruction loss of CVAE reconstructions is <= 12/255; (3) one non-optimized CVAE sample per image, evaluated with the same YOLO11n detector and person AP50 protocol as the gate, has AP50 >= 0.90 and relative AP50 degradation from the clean gate result <= 5%. Failure of any condition means the apparatus is not accepted for testing the claim.
constraints_not_enforced: headline adversarial AP50 under optimized perturbations
depends_on: Verify the clean-performance prerequisite for the claimed robust AP50 on COCO val2017 person at 640x640
experiment_recipes.rationale: The claim presupposes a learned generative perturbation model whose outputs are bounded and structure-preserving enough to be treated as illumination-consistent image modifications; this must be validated before attributing robustness results to that apparatus.
experiment_recipes.label: norm_card_method

experiment_recipes.goal: Directly test whether YOLO11n retains AP50 >= 0.90 with <= 5% relative degradation under the claimed white-box projected CVAE perturbations
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Using the frozen CVAE from the apparatus recipe, generate adversarially modified COCO val2017 images by white-box projected optimization against YOLO11n with inputs normalized to [0,1], resolution 640x640, and L_infinity projection eps = 12/255. Evaluate only the person class with AP50 at IoU >= 0.5. Pass only if all conditions hold: (1) every adversarial image satisfies L_infinity norm of perturbation <= 12/255; (2) adversarial person AP50 >= 0.90; (3) (clean_AP50 - adversarial_AP50) / clean_AP50 <= 0.05, where clean_AP50 is from the gate recipe. If any condition fails, the claim is refuted.
depends_on: Verify the clean-performance prerequisite for the claimed robust AP50 on COCO val2017 person at 640x640
Build and validate the learned CVAE perturbation apparatus before using it for the headline adversarial evaluation
experiment_recipes.rationale: This is the exact asserted evaluation: COCO-pretrained YOLO11n, COCO val2017 person class, 640x640 resolution, AP50 at IoU 0.5, white-box projected adversarial image modifications, and eps = 12/255.
experiment_recipes.label: norm_card_method

experiment_recipes.goal: Check that the white-box CVAE optimizer is stronger than a non-optimized CVAE perturbation control at the same perturbation budget
experiment_recipes.attack_or_condition: Use L_p norms to define/constrain adversarial perturbations
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: At eps = 12/255 and 640x640 resolution, compare the headline white-box optimized CVAE perturbations with random non-optimized CVAE perturbations from the same frozen CVAE. Pass only if: (1) both perturbation sets satisfy L_infinity norm <= 12/255 for 100% of images; (2) optimized_CVAE_AP50 <= random_CVAE_AP50; (3) optimized_CVAE_AP50 still satisfies AP50 >= 0.90 and <= 5% relative degradation from clean_AP50. If optimized_CVAE_AP50 > random_CVAE_AP50, the headline attack is considered too weak to verify the claim; if optimized_CVAE_AP50 violates the AP50 or 5% degradation threshold, the claim is refuted.
constraints_not_enforced: attack-strength behavior at eps values below 12/255
depends_on: Directly test whether YOLO11n retains AP50 >= 0.90 with <= 5% relative degradation under the claimed white-box projected CVAE perturbations
experiment_recipes.rationale: A white-box adversarial optimization should not be weaker than a matched-budget non-optimized perturbation baseline; otherwise an apparent robustness pass could be an optimizer artifact.
experiment_recipes.label: norm_card_method

experiment_recipes.goal: Verify robustness across the allowed perturbation budget and detect attack-strength artifacts
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Repeat the same white-box projected CVAE attack at eps in {0, 4/255, 8/255, 12/255}. Pass only if for every eps value: (1) 100% of perturbations satisfy L_infinity norm <= eps; (2) person AP50 >= 0.90; (3) relative degradation from clean_AP50 is <= 5%. Additionally, AP50 at eps = 12/255 must be no greater than AP50 at eps = 0 under the same evaluation protocol. If any eps <= 12/255 violates AP50 >= 0.90 or <= 5% degradation, the claim is refuted because that perturbation lies inside the claimed eps = 12/255 threat budget.
depends_on: Directly test whether YOLO11n retains AP50 >= 0.90 with <= 5% relative degradation under the claimed white-box projected CVAE perturbations
experiment_recipes.rationale: Robustness to an eps = 12/255 bounded adversary conventionally includes perturbations within that budget, and an epsilon sweep helps expose failed projection, weak optimization, or non-reproducible attack behavior.
experiment_recipes.label: norm_card_method

baseline_recipes.goal: Verify the clean prerequisite: Ultralytics YOLO11n pretrained on COCO reaches AP50 >= 0.90 on the COCO val2017 person class at 640x640
baseline_recipes.dataset: COCO val2017, person class only, official annotations, images resized/letterboxed to 640x640 using Ultralytics default validation pipeline
baseline_recipes.model: Ultralytics YOLO11n pretrained COCO weights, e.g. yolo11n.pt
baseline_recipes.method_under_test: Clean evaluation with no adversarial or generative perturbation
baseline_recipes.attack_or_condition: No attack; confidence/NMS settings fixed to Ultralytics validation defaults; evaluate only category_id=1/person for AP50 at IoU=0.5
baseline_recipes.pass_condition: Pass only if clean person AP50 >= 0.90 on COCO val2017 at 640x640. If clean person AP50 < 0.90, refute the claim immediately because adversarial performance cannot retain AP50 >= 0.90 with nonnegative degradation from this clean baseline.
constraints_not_enforced: CVAE learned generative illumination-consistent perturbation model
baseline_recipes.rationale: The claimed adversarial AP50 threshold presupposes that the same detector already achieves at least that AP50 cleanly. This is the cheapest decisive refutation test.
baseline_recipes.label: baseline

baseline_recipes.goal: Build and validate the learned conditional generative illumination-consistent perturbation model before using it for attacks
baseline_recipes.dataset: Training: COCO train2017 images or a disjoint illumination-augmentation training set derived from COCO train2017; Validation: held-out COCO val2017 subset with person instances, not used for CVAE training
baseline_recipes.model: Conditional CVAE perturbation generator conditioned on the clean image, with latent variables optimized at attack time; YOLO11n frozen for downstream compatibility checks
baseline_recipes.method_under_test: Train a CVAE to generate additive illumination-like perturbations delta(x,z), then project or scale outputs so x_adv=clip(x+delta,0,1) satisfies the image-space L_inf budget
baseline_recipes.attack_or_condition: Sample multiple latent codes per validation image without using labels or detector gradients; evaluate whether generated perturbations are illumination-consistent and structure-preserving
metrics: clean-label person AP50 under random CVAE samples
baseline_recipes.pass_condition: Pass only if all of the following hold on the held-out validation subset: 100% of generated samples satisfy max_pixel |x_adv-x| <= 12/255; mean SSIM(x,x_adv) >= 0.98; at least 90% of perturbation spectral energy lies in the lowest quarter of spatial frequencies; edge-map preservation F1 >= 0.95; and person AP50 under random non-adversarial CVAE samples degrades by <= 5% relative to clean AP50. Failure of any condition means the apparatus is not a valid illumination-consistent, structure-preserving perturbation model for the claim.
depends_on: Verify the clean prerequisite: Ultralytics YOLO11n pretrained on COCO reaches AP50 >= 0.90 on the COCO val2017 person class at 640x640
baseline_recipes.rationale: The headline claim depends on a learned illumination-consistent generative perturbation model. Before testing robustness, the generator must be shown to produce bounded, illumination-like, non-destructive image modifications rather than arbitrary noise or object-corrupting artifacts.
baseline_recipes.label: baseline

baseline_recipes.goal: Validate that the latent-space PGD attack implementation is truly white-box, differentiable, projected, and respects the eps=12/255 image-space constraint
baseline_recipes.dataset: Small fixed development subset of COCO val2017 person images, separate from the final headline reporting subset if tuning attack hyperparameters
baseline_recipes.model: Frozen Ultralytics YOLO11n plus validated conditional CVAE generator
baseline_recipes.method_under_test: White-box PGD through the CVAE decoder and YOLO11n detection loss, optimizing latent variables while projecting generated images to the image-space L_inf ball
baseline_recipes.attack_or_condition: Run short PGD attacks with several step sizes and restarts; compute gradients through the detector pre-NMS loss with respect to latent variables; after every step enforce x_adv in [0,1] and ||x_adv-x||_inf <= 12/255
baseline_recipes.pass_condition: Pass only if 100% of attacked images satisfy ||x_adv-x||_inf <= 12/255 at every PGD step and at final output; at least 99% of attack batches have finite nonzero latent gradients; and the final PGD detection loss is greater than the initial latent loss in at least 95% of attacked images. Otherwise the headline attack is invalid or not actually enforcing the claim constraints.
constraints_not_enforced: full COCO val2017 AP50 headline threshold
depends_on: Build and validate the learned conditional generative illumination-consistent perturbation model before using it for attacks
baseline_recipes.rationale: A robustness result under latent PGD is meaningful only if the implementation really performs white-box gradient optimization and projection under the stated image-space L_inf budget.
baseline_recipes.label: baseline

baseline_recipes.goal: Directly test the claim: YOLO11n retains person AP50 >= 0.90 with <= 5% relative degradation under white-box latent PGD CVAE illumination perturbations bounded by eps=12/255
baseline_recipes.dataset: Full COCO val2017 split, official person annotations only, 640x640 Ultralytics validation preprocessing
baseline_recipes.model: Ultralytics YOLO11n pretrained COCO weights, frozen; validated conditional CVAE perturbation model
baseline_recipes.method_under_test: White-box projected gradient descent over CVAE latent variables against YOLO11n person detection objective
baseline_recipes.attack_or_condition: For every COCO val2017 image, generate x_adv by PGD over latent variables with multiple random restarts, fixed attack budget, projection to ||x_adv-x||_inf <= 12/255, and clipping to valid image range; evaluate detections on x_adv at 640x640 using the same AP code as clean evaluation
metrics: relative AP50 degradation=(clean AP50 - adversarial AP50)/clean AP50
baseline_recipes.pass_condition: Pass only if all are true on full COCO val2017 person evaluation: adversarial person AP50 >= 0.90; relative AP50 degradation <= 0.05; and 100% of adversarial images satisfy ||x_adv-x||_inf <= 12/255. If adversarial AP50 < 0.90, or relative degradation > 5%, or any image violates the L_inf bound, refute the claim.
depends_on: Verify the clean prerequisite: Ultralytics YOLO11n pretrained on COCO reaches AP50 >= 0.90 on the COCO val2017 person class at 640x640
Build and validate the learned conditional generative illumination-consistent perturbation model before using it for attacks
Validate that the latent-space PGD attack implementation is truly white-box, differentiable, projected, and respects the eps=12/255 image-space constraint
baseline_recipes.rationale: This is the exact asserted setting: pretrained YOLO11n, COCO val2017 person class, AP50 at IoU 0.5, 640x640 resolution, learned generative illumination perturbations, white-box PGD over latent variables, and eps=12/255 image-space constraint.
baseline_recipes.label: baseline

baseline_recipes.goal: Check that the reported robustness is not caused by a weak or ineffective latent optimizer
baseline_recipes.dataset: COCO val2017 person images at 640x640; may use the full split or a fixed statistically powered subset if compute-limited, with the same subset used for all attacks
baseline_recipes.model: Ultralytics YOLO11n pretrained COCO weights plus validated conditional CVAE generator
baseline_recipes.method_under_test: Compare optimized latent PGD against random latent sampling and weaker optimizers under the identical CVAE and L_inf budget
baseline_recipes.attack_or_condition: Run matched-budget attacks: random latent samples, single-step latent FGSM/PGD, and multi-step latent PGD with multiple restarts; all outputs projected to ||x_adv-x||_inf <= 12/255
metrics: person AP50 for random latent perturbations
person AP50 for one-step latent attack
person AP50 for multi-step latent PGD
baseline_recipes.pass_condition: Pass only if multi-step PGD is at least as damaging as all weaker controls: AP50_multi_step_PGD <= AP50_random_latent and AP50_multi_step_PGD <= AP50_one_step_attack, with all methods satisfying ||x_adv-x||_inf <= 12/255 on 100% of images. If random or weaker attacks produce lower AP50 than the claimed PGD attack, the headline attack is not a reliable worst-case test and the robustness conclusion is invalid.
constraints_not_enforced: This control may be run on a subset rather than full COCO val2017 if compute-limited; if subset is used, it does not enforce the full-split headline AP50 threshold
depends_on: Directly test the claim: YOLO11n retains person AP50 >= 0.90 with <= 5% relative degradation under white-box latent PGD CVAE illumination perturbations bounded by eps=12/255
baseline_recipes.rationale: A standard adversarial-evaluation sanity check is that the optimized attack should be no weaker than random perturbations or fewer-step attacks under the same threat model and budget.
baseline_recipes.label: baseline

baseline_recipes.goal: Check attack-strength saturation and projection sensitivity for the latent PGD threat model
baseline_recipes.dataset: COCO val2017 person images at 640x640; preferably full split, otherwise the same fixed subset as the optimizer-strength control
baseline_recipes.model: Ultralytics YOLO11n pretrained COCO weights plus validated conditional CVAE generator
baseline_recipes.method_under_test: Latent PGD with varying numbers of steps, step sizes, and restarts, always under the same eps=12/255 image-space budget
baseline_recipes.attack_or_condition: Sweep PGD steps, e.g. 10, 25, 50, 100, and restarts, e.g. 1, 5, 10; choose the strongest valid configuration by lowest person AP50 while enforcing ||x_adv-x||_inf <= 12/255
metrics: person AP50 at each PGD budget
relative AP50 degradation at each PGD budget
baseline_recipes.pass_condition: Pass only if the strongest valid swept configuration still satisfies the headline thresholds: adversarial person AP50 >= 0.90 and relative degradation <= 5%, with 100% of images satisfying ||x_adv-x||_inf <= 12/255; additionally, increasing the PGD budget from the selected headline setting to the maximum swept setting must not lower AP50 by more than 1 absolute AP50 point. If a stronger valid attack violates AP50 >= 0.90 or degradation <= 5%, refute the robustness claim.
constraints_not_enforced: If run on a subset, this control does not by itself enforce full COCO val2017 headline AP50
depends_on: Directly test the claim: YOLO11n retains person AP50 >= 0.90 with <= 5% relative degradation under white-box latent PGD CVAE illumination perturbations bounded by eps=12/255
Check that the reported robustness is not caused by a weak or ineffective latent optimizer
baseline_recipes.rationale: Robustness claims under PGD require evidence that the attack is not under-optimized. Step/restart sweeps test whether the reported AP is stable to stronger optimization within the same threat model.
baseline_recipes.label: baseline
